QuestInfo.name: A Zenumist Pact
QuestInfo.0: You got the Zenumists on your side. Return to #p9390368#.
QuestInfo.1: #p9390368# wants you to bribe #p2111001# next. You can find him at the Alcadno Society.
QuestInfo.2: You gave the #t4034054# to #p2111001#. #p2111001# loved the bribe and promised to help you locate #o8860000#. Go back to #p9390368#.

1.0: Who goes there? I smell a Zenumist somewhere.

yes.0: Hm, a bribe? That doesn't look like much of... Wait! Is this #t4034054#?! I've been dying for one of these!
yes.1: I don't appreciate that you went to the Zenumists first, but your gift may have earned you a favor.
yes.2: I bet you're looking into the laboratory break-in.
yes.3: Hmph, it's nothing. We know a lot more than you think. I know everything those Zenumists know, and more.
yes.4: It's true, our laboratory suffered an intrusion as well, but we honestly don't know who did it. The shame of having our security compromised...
yes.5: Commander #o8860000#? So we are being linked to the Tournament of Heroes kidnapping?  Blast it all!
yes.6: You're willing to sweep them from our premises? That is a tempting offer...
yes.7: Go back for now. I'm busy with my current research. I'll send a courier with a map of our facilities to you later.
